topic.title: Core Identification

body.p: All logical processors within the CPU package have identical CPUID signature with unique family/model/stepping information. Refer to Section 2.2 for the encodings.
The CPUID feature flag for identify Hetero Architecture and enumerate the core type are added to support Hybrid CPUs:
IF CPUID.(EAX=07H, ECX=00H):EDX[15] = ‘1’, indicates the processor is a hybrid processor.
IF CPUID.(EAX=1AH, ECX=00H):EAX[31:24] = ‘20H’, indicates it is an Atom core
IF CPUID.(EAX=1AH, ECX=00H):EAX[31:24] = ‘40H’, indicates it is an Intel core
Refer to CPUID Feature Flag of the Intel® 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer’s Manual Vol. 2A for details.
